bullets.text: Wildfires in south-west France are flaring up again as the region prepares for a new heatwave with temperatures expected to reach 40C, complicating efforts to contain the blazes.
Uganda has started emergency food handouts following the deaths of 19 people from hunger, after months of drought and crop failures left 1.5 million people facing malnutrition in the Karamoja region.

Two Russian men have been jailed in Angola after being found guilty of terrorism and spying, in connection with an alleged plan to stage a coup and organize deadly demonstrations over fuel prices last year.
Victoria has a new premier after Ben Carroll was voted in by the Labor party, following Jacinta Allan's resignation.
Police have charged nine teenagers over alleged carjackings in Melbourne's northern suburbs, with the group believed to be responsible for 18 incidents this month.
Hundreds of social housing tenants in Queensland have been evicted after a review found they either owned property or earned more than $80,000 annually.

Chip stocks experienced a significant sell-off, with the Nasdaq 100 briefly entering correction territory, even as Apple's valuation topped $5 trillion for the first time, benefiting from its lower AI spending and investor flight to safety.
Emerging market currencies saw mixed trading as oil prices plunged due to optimism regarding US-Iran talks, and traders adjusted positions ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision.

FIFA plans to launch a $20 billion commercial vehicle to attract external investors, with Joshua Kushner expected to lead an investment group, as the governing body seeks to capitalize on the World Cup's commercial potential.
